name.value: State Street SPDR S&P World ex Australia Carbon Aware ETF
name.note: State Street writes it with trademark signs. Renamed on 19 Dec 2025 (State Street); State Street says the strategy did not change. The previous name, SPDR S&P World ex Australia Carbon Control Fund, comes from third-party sites, not State Street. Before the index change on 31 Jan 2022 it was the SPDR S&P World ex Australia Fund (State Street's old page address).

index.value: S&P Developed Ex-Australia LargeMidCap Carbon Aware Index (in AUD, unhedged)
index.note: Tracked the S&P Developed ex Australia LargeMidCap AUD Index from inception until 31 Jan 2022 (State Street fact sheet). Not currency hedged.

yield.note: State Street's 1-year 'Fund Distribution Return' to 30 Sep 2026: the part of the 1-year total return that came from distributions (NAV basis, distributions reinvested). This is high because the one yearly distribution (A$3.00, ex 29 Jun 2026) was mostly realised gains, not dividends; 2023's was A$1.62. The dividend yield of the shares held was 1.67% at 16 Oct 2026 (State Street), which is closer to the ongoing income.

franking.note: State Street publishes 0.000000 franking credits per unit for every distribution; overseas shares carry no franking credits.

listed.note: First day of trading on the ASX (ASX company listing date). Daily prices start here. State Street gives the ASX quotation date as 18 Mar 2013, one day earlier.

inception.note: Fund inception; ASX lists it from 19 Mar 2013 (State Street says quoted 18 Mar 2013)
